title: Gate 1 Entry Attempt — Unauthorized Truck

lines.text: FSO, this is Gate 1 Officer. A truck driver in a 2017 Peterbilt with a Virginia license plate is trying to enter with a no-authorization sticker on his manifest. He says he's from 'ClearFlow Logistics' and needs to deliver to Dock 1. His ID doesn't match the system.
Copy, Gate 1. Hold the vehicle. I'm checking the manifest against the pre-approval list now.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: Noise inject; the FSO should verify the manifest and deny entry, but not escalate unless challenged.
